entry.name: graphName
entry.label: DB graph to use. Empty means the CLI's current graph.

entry.name: cliPath
entry.label: Path to the logseq CLI. Empty means ~/.local/bin/logseq or PATH.

entry.name: appImagePath
entry.label: Logseq AppImage. Empty means find it from the launcher or common folders.

entry.name: pythonCommand
entry.label: Python 3 interpreter used to run the helper.

entry.name: backgroundSync
entry.label: Keep Logseq Sync running while Logseq Desktop is closed.

entry.name: showCompletedTasks
entry.label: Show completed and canceled tasks by default.

entry.name: taskTagFilter
entry.label: Tag the TODO list is filtered by: a tag id, -1 for all tags, -2 for untagged.

entry.name: taskTargetPage
entry.label: Page that receives new tasks. Empty means today's journal.
